items.html: *And now we must explain the matter of ZA: when he and the Nukva are born, to what place they are pushed at the time of birth. And behold, in all the gates that preceded, every matter was explained in its place — how Arich, when he was born, first descended to the place of BYA, and afterward rose little by little to his place; and likewise AVI, each one in his place. However, the matter of ZON we shall explain now. And it is as follows: for behold, it was explained above how Atik clothes within Arich, and the two last joints of his Netzah and Hod remain exposed below the feet of Arich, beneath the world of Atzilut; and these enter into the boundary of what will afterward be the world of Beria.
